---
title: Web Map Services(WMS)
# sidebar_position: 2
---

1. **Introduction** 

   The OpenGIS® Web Map Service Interface Standard (WMS) provides a simple HTTP interface for requesting geo-registered map images from one or more distributed geospatial databases. A WMS request defines the geographic layer(s) and area of interest to be processed. The response to the request is one or more geo-registered map images (returned as JPEG, PNG, etc) that can be displayed in a browser application. The interface also supports the ability to specify whether the returned images should be transparent so that layers from multiple servers can be combined or not.

1. **WMS using HTTP KVP encoding and Restful**

 **Define path info:**
- `@hostname = http://10.225.0.234`
- `@apipath = /vietbando/api/v1/wms`

 **KVP:**
- **GetCapabilities** operation is to obtain service metadata, which is a machine-readable (and human-readable) description of the server’s information content and acceptable request parameter values.
- *URL: `GET:{{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities`*
- *Parameter:*
```
SERVICE: Service type identifier,Character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMS".
REQUEST :Operation name|Character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetCapabilities".
```
```
Ex:{{hostname}}/{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3\_OGC?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities
```
- *Illustrating Image:*

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Image 1. GetCapabilities by ID vbdmapv3\_OGC   (Postman)

- **GetMap** operation returns a map. Upon receiving a GetMap request, a WMS shall either satisfy the request or issue a service exception.
- *URL:*
```
  GET {{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMS&VERSION=1.3.0&REQUEST=GetMap&BBOX=zzz,ccc,vvv,bbb&CRS=nnn&WIDTH=www&HEIGHT=hhh&LAYERS=lll&FORMAT=ff
```
- *Parameter*
```
SERVICE: Service type identifier|Character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMS".
REQUEST: Operation name, Character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetMap".
BBOX: Bounding box for map extent. Value is minx,miny,maxx,maxy in units of the SRS. Character string type.
LAYERS: Layers to display on map. Value is a comma-separated list of layer names, character string type.
CRS: Spatial Reference System for map output. Value is in form EPSG:nnnn. crs is the parameter key used in WMS 1.3.0, character string type.
WIDTH: Width of map output, in pixels, character string type.
HEIGHT: Height of map output, in pixels, character string type.
FORMAT: Output format, character String type(image/png).
VERSION: Version service WMS support, character string type (1.3.0) or (1.1.0).
```
```
Ex: {{hostname}}{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3_OGC?SERVICE=WMS&VERSION=1.3.0&REQUEST=GetMap&BBOX=12040399.70369838923,1248924.752498530317,12142901.75861454383,1313896.22653188603&CRS=EPSG:3857&WIDTH=1341&HEIGHT=850&LAYERS=region_sea&STYLES=&FORMAT=image/png
```

- *Illustrating Image:*

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. **GetFeatureInfo:**
- **GetFeatureInfo** operation returns features. Upon receiving a GetFeatureInfo request, a WMS shall either satisfy the request or issue a service exception.
- *URL:*
```
  GET {{hostname}}{{apipath}}/{id}?SERVICE=WMS&VERSION=1.3.0&REQUEST=GetFeatureInfo&BBOX=zzz,ccc,vvv,bbb&CRS=nnn&WIDTH=www&HEIGHT=hhh&LAYERS=lll&FORMAT=fff&INFO_FORMAT=lll&I=iii&J=jjj
```
- *Parameter*
```
SERVICE: Service type identifier|Character String type, not empty SHALL be "WMS".
REQUEST: Operation name, Character String type, not empty SHALL be "GetFeatureInfo".
BBOX: Bounding box for map extent. Value is minx,miny,maxx,maxy in units of the SRS Character String type.
LAYERS: Layers to display on map. Value is a comma-separated list of layer names, Character String type.
CRS: Spatial Reference System for map output. Value is in form EPSG:nnnn. crs is the parameter key used in WMS 1.3.0, Character String type.
WIDTH: Width of map output, in pixels, Character String type.
HEIGHT: Height of map output, in pixels, Character String type.
FORMAT: Output format, Character String type(image/png).
VERSION: Version service WMS support, Character String type (1.3.0) or (1.1.0).
J: Row index of a pixel within the tile|Non negative integer type value between 0 and TileHeight-1 of this tile matrix defined in the ServiceMetadata document.
I: Column index of a pixel within the tile|Non negative integer type value between 0 and TileWidth-1 of this tile matrix defined in the ServiceMetadata document
```
```
Ex: {{hostname}}{{apipath}}/vbdmapv3_OGC? SERVICE=WMS&VERSION=1.3.0&REQUEST=GetFeatureInfo&BBOX=11878386.6128096804022789,1180008.7836316388566047,11895803.35701161623001099,1191842.70255381637252867&CRS=EPSG:900913&WIDTH=1251&HEIGHT=850&LAYERS=region_vnriver&STYLES=&FORMAT=image/png&QUERY_LAYERS=region_vnriver&INFO_FORMAT=application/json&I=633&J=486
```

- *Illustrating Image:*


![](data:image/png;base64,)

Image 5. GetFeatureInfo by ID vbdmapv3\_OGC and layer= region\_vnriver (Qgis)

**ServerExternal:**
- **ServerExternal** allows adding more Mapnik servers external and use the parameter "SERVERNAME= XXXX" when make the request.
- *Url:*
```

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WMSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wms?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

GET : http://{{Host}}:{{WMSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wms?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

POST : http://{{Host}}:{{WMSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wms?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=ServerExternal

DELETE : http://{{Host}}:{{WMSPort}}/Vietbando/api/v1/wms?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=ServerExternal&NAME={Id}

```
- *Example body:*
```
{
    "Id": "mapnik_2",
    "Host": "http://10.222.3.82",
    "Port": "8083"
}
```
(\*)Updating and deleting capabilities can be performed when the ID does not exist in the list of capabilities retrieved from the GetListMaps API.
